title: Action on Extended Work Tapes
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-tape Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let its auxiliary control-state set be the state set used by the construction. Given an input-head movement, an action for each of the $M.k$ work tapes, three further work-tape actions, an optional output symbol, and an optional successor auxiliary control state, form the action on $M.k+3$ work tapes that uses those work-tape actions in that order and retains the supplied input-head movement, output symbol, and successor state.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-tape Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
An action is supplied for each of the $M.k$ work tapes
Three further work-tape actions are supplied
